_about: FIX26 §1.1 — ordinary Thai chat prose that contains NO personal data. Every registered detector must stay silent on every line. Built by hand from the registers a person actually types into this product: questions, instructions, small talk, technical requests, work chatter, and numbers that are not identifiers (prices, quantities, times, dates without a person, percentages, versions). NOT covered: formal/legal documents, Isan/Northern dialect, mixed Thai-English transliteration of names, poetry, long-form articles, OCR noise.
